action.ambiguous.header: Several action plans are awaiting confirmation in this conversation. Say which one, for example "confirm 1":
action.cancel_already_handled: This action plan has already been handled (current status: %s), so it cannot be cancelled.
action.cancelled: Action plan cancelled, nothing was run.
action.pending_expired: The pending proposal has expired: ask for the action again to get a new one.
action.plan_already_handled: This action plan has already been handled (current status: %s).
action.plan_expired: This action plan has expired: ask again and I will propose it anew.
action.plan_forbidden: You are not allowed to confirm this action plan.
action.plan_just_handled: This action plan has just been handled.
action.plan_not_found: There is no plan number %d awaiting confirmation in this conversation.
action.proposal.footer: Reply "confirm" to run them, or "cancel" to drop them. This proposal expires in %s.
action.proposal.superseded: (replaces the previous proposal, which went unanswered)
action.report.all_succeeded: Every action in the plan ran successfully:
action.report.none: No action in the plan could be run:
agent.actions_over_limit: ⚠️ This turn produced %d actions to confirm, beyond the limit of %d set for agent %q. Nothing was recorded: ask again, split into several steps.
audio.empty_transcription: I could not hear anything in this voice message. Record it again a little closer to the microphone, or write to me instead.
audio.too_large: This voice message is too long for me to process. Send a shorter one, or write to me instead.
audio.unsupported_format: I cannot read this audio format. Send me a voice message recorded from WhatsApp, or write to me instead.
credits.allowance_note: Your allowance returns to %s credits %s. It does not carry over — no point in saving it.
credits.autotopup_off_body: Top up automatically as soon as the balance drops below a threshold. Coming with online payment.
credits.autotopup_on_body: We top up %s credits as soon as you drop below %s. Nothing for you to watch.
credits.heading: Your credits
credits.hint.approaching: You are approaching your monthly allowance
credits.hint.barely_started: You have barely started your month
credits.hint.exhausted: Your monthly allowance is used up
credits.hint.good_part: You have used a good part of your month
credits.hint.under_half: You have used a little under half your month
credits.low_note: Nothing is cut off yet. Topping up now avoids an interruption.
credits.notice.error: We could not open the payment page. Try again in a moment.
credits.notice.paid: Thank you! Your payment is confirmed. Your credits arrive in a few seconds — refresh if the balance has not moved yet.
credits.offered_note: This access is offered to you by Automata. Nothing to pay, nothing to renew.
credits.paused_body: Your memories, your reminders and your conversations are intact. Top up and everything resumes where you left it.
credits.paused_title: Automata is waiting for you; its credits have run out
credits.payment_closed: Online payment is not open yet. Your credits can be added by whoever runs the service.
credits.tax_note: Prices exclude tax: applicable VAT is added at payment. Payment handled by Stripe; your credits are added as soon as it is confirmed.
credits.title: Your credits — Automata
credits.unlimited_body: No cap, nothing to top up. You used %s credits this month — for information only, nothing is deducted.
credits.unlimited_note: This access is offered to you by Automata, without limit. Nothing to pay, nothing to renew.
discover.calendar.detail: I check when you are free and book your appointments, once you confirm.
discover.calendar.example: Am I free on Thursday afternoon?
discover.calendar.title: Keep your calendar
discover.email.detail: Once your mailbox is connected, I can check it and draft your replies — you approve them before anything is sent.
discover.email.example: What important messages did I get today?
discover.email.title: Read and write your email
discover.files.detail: Send me a document, an image or a video: I can convert them, trim them, pull out what you need.
discover.files.example: Send a photo, then: "crop it square and make it lighter".
discover.files.title: Work on your files
discover.footer: You can ask me at any time what I remember about you, and ask me to forget it. It is all in the Privacy tab too.
discover.heading: What you can ask me
discover.intro: Write to me as you would to a person, in your usual conversation. Here is somewhere to start — copy an example as it is.
discover.locker.detail: What I keep for you stays available months later, unlike files just passing through.
discover.locker.example: Keep this contract, I will need it next month.
discover.locker.title: Keep your documents
discover.pages.detail: A report, a poster, a form: I put them online and give you the link.
discover.pages.example: Make me a page with the programme for the street party.
discover.pages.title: Publish a page
discover.remember.detail: Tell me what to keep in mind, and I will remember it in our next conversations.
discover.remember.example: Remember that my business partner is called Lina and that she handles the accounts.
discover.remember.title: Remember what matters
discover.remind.detail: A deadline, an appointment, a habit: I warn you at the right time.
discover.remind.example: Remind me on Friday morning to send the invoice to Lina.
discover.remind.title: Remind you of something
discover.search.detail: Ask a question whose answer is on the web, and I bring back what matters rather than a list of links.
discover.search.example: What are the opening hours of the Meylan recycling centre?
discover.search.title: Search for you
discover.title: Discover — Automata
discover.visit_running.body: Pick the conversation up whenever you like: I will ask my question again. Reply "skip" to stop there.
discover.visit_running.title: We were getting to know each other
duration.usage.less_than_day: Less than a day of ordinary use
duration.usage.one_day: About a day of ordinary use
duration.usage.one_month: About a month of ordinary use
duration.usage.one_week: About a week of ordinary use
duration.usage.three_weeks: About three weeks of ordinary use
duration.usage.two_months: About two months of ordinary use
duration.usage.two_weeks: About two weeks of ordinary use
ingress.fallback_reply: Sorry, I could not process this message. Try again in a moment.
link.error.body: We could not open this page. Try again in a moment, or tell Automata in your conversation.
link.error.heading: Something did not work
link.expired.ask_body: Go back to your conversation and write to Automata: "send me my profile link".
link.expired.body: That is normal: links live only a quarter of an hour, so nobody else can open your profile.
link.expired.heading: This link has expired
link.open.heading: Hello %s
link.open.intro: Your credits, your recovery address and your personal data. The page stays open for about fifteen minutes.
link.open.warning: This link opens only once, and belongs to you alone: do not pass it on.
link.used.ask_body: In your conversation, just write "my profile". It answers with a new link.
link.used.body: Each link opens only once. If you closed the page too soon, just ask for another.
link.used.heading: This link has already been used
linking.already_linked: This messaging account is already attached to another profile. Contact whoever manages your access.
linking.group_linked: This conversation is now attached to "%s". Mention me when you need me — I only read what is addressed to me.
linking.token_invalid: This code is no longer valid. Ask whoever manages your access for a new one.
linking.welcome: Hello %s! Your account is linked and I am at your disposal. Write to me as you would to a person: I can remember what matters, remind you of things, work on the files you send me and keep your documents.
mail.verification.ignore: If you did not ask for this, simply ignore this message.
mail.verification.instructions: Enter it on the profile page opened from your conversation with Automata. It expires in ten minutes.
mail.verification.subject: Your Automata code: %s
memories.empty: I remember nothing about you yet. Say "remember that…" in our conversation.
memories.error_read: Your memories could not be read. Try again in a moment.
memories.error_update: This memory could not be changed. Reload the page and try again.
memories.group_note: What I remember from group conversations does not appear here: those memories belong to the group, not to you alone.
memories.heading: What I remember about you
memories.intro: Here, word for word, is what I use to answer you. Correct or erase anything wrong — I rely on it.
memories.notice_deleted: Memory erased. I will not use it again.
memories.notice_updated: Memory corrected. I will stick to this version.
memories.title: What I remember — Automata
mission.stalled: I can no longer make progress on "%s": the last %d wake-ups failed. I will keep trying; you can also drop the mission if it no longer serves.
missions.confirm_abandon: Drop this case? I will stop checking in on it.
missions.empty: No cases. Ask me to follow a matter — "follow up my complaint and chase them if nobody answers" — and it will appear here.
missions.heading: My cases
missions.intro: The matters I follow for you over time. At every check-in I note where the case stands — that log is what I reread before acting.
missions.notice_abandoned: Case dropped. I will stop checking in on it.
missions.title: Cases — Automata
onboarding.done: Thank you, I am noting all of that. You can now ask me for whatever you need: remembering something, reminding you of a deadline, working on a file you send me, or keeping a document safe. Just tell me what you need.
onboarding.offer: Shall we get to know each other in four questions? Reply "yes" — or just ask me what you need, and we will get there along the way.
onboarding.q1: What would you like me to call you?
onboarding.q2: Which time zone do you live in, and when are you usually available? That way I will not offer you a reminder at 3 in the morning.
onboarding.q3: What are you working on, in a few words? I will know what you mean when you mention a project or a case.
onboarding.q4: Last question: do you prefer short answers that get straight to the point, or more detailed ones?
onboarding.stopped: Understood, let us stop there. I am here whenever you need me.
privacy.correct.body: Your memories can be read and changed one by one — a wrong memory is worth less than no memory at all.
privacy.correct.title: Correct what I remember
privacy.delete.body: Your private messages, your memories and your reminders will be erased, and your account detached from your messaging app. Group conversations stay: they belong to the other participants too. Your usage records are kept without being attached to you, because they serve as accounting evidence.
privacy.delete.title: Delete permanently
privacy.deleted.body_long: Automata no longer recognises you in your messaging app. If you write again, it will answer you as a stranger — a new code will be needed to link you.
privacy.deleted.title: Done
privacy.error_confirmation: To delete your data, type exactly %s.
privacy.export.body: A readable file, to keep wherever you like.
privacy.heading: Your data
privacy.intro: Here is what Automata keeps about you, and what you can do about it.
privacy.item.email.detail: %s — used only to find you again if you lose access to your messaging app.
privacy.item.email.title: Your recovery address
privacy.item.memories.detail: What Automata keeps in order to be useful to you: your preferences, your habits, what you asked it not to forget.
privacy.item.memories.title: What it remembered about you
privacy.item.messages.detail: What you wrote to Automata one to one, and its replies.
privacy.item.messages.title: Your private conversations
privacy.item.usage.detail: How much you exchanged, month by month. These records serve as accounting evidence.
privacy.item.usage.title: Your usage
privacy.report: %s and %s were erased, along with your reminders and your recovery address.
privacy.title: Your data — Automata
profile.email.card_body: We will use it for that only. No newsletters.
profile.email.close_hint: You can close this page: Automata will send you another link if you need one — just ask in your conversation.
profile.email.error_code: This code does not match. Check the six digits, or send yourself another.
profile.email.intro: An email address lets us find you again if you change phone or number.
profile.email.mail_off: Email sending is not configured on this instance yet
profile.email.verified_note: Address verified. We will use it only to find you again.
profile.heading: Your profile
profile.language.body: The language of this page and of the messages Automata writes on its own. In conversation, it always answers in the language you write to it.
profile.title: Your profile — Automata
suggestions.confirm_mute: Automata will never propose anything again. Continue?
suggestions.empty: Nothing yet. I only propose what rests on real observations — silence beats a bad idea.
suggestions.heading: My suggestions
suggestions.intro: Every week I think about what I could do better for you. Here is what I found.
suggestions.muted.body: I no longer look for improvements for you, and I will not propose anything.
suggestions.muted.title: Suggestions are turned off
suggestions.notice_accepted: Noted. This kind of suggestion will keep coming.
suggestions.notice_dismissed: Dismissed. I will not propose it again.
suggestions.notice_unmuted: Turned back on. My next round of thinking is early next week.
suggestions.title: Suggestions — Automata
usage.heading: My usage
usage.shared_note: These figures cover your whole organisation, not just you: credits are shared.
usage.summary.less: You are using Automata less than last month.
usage.summary.more: You are using Automata noticeably more than last month.
usage.summary.plain: Here is what your exchanges with Automata used this month.
usage.summary.same: Your usage looks like last month's.
usage.title: My usage — Automata
